name: Directed (Magic Armor or Shield Quality)
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Price +1 bonus; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

These shields were made to defend against single foes. When wielding a directed shield the bearer gains a +10 bonus vs. a designated opponent’s attempts to feint. Designating a foe is a swift action.

The shield’s AC bonus also increases by +1 when being threatened by only a single opponent.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Combat Expertise
